scope_of_deliverables.value: Cowichan Tribes, a First Nation band in British Columbia, is seeking to procure a cloud-based Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system to enhance operational efficiency across key functions including finance, procurement, human resources, payroll, and asset management. The scope is detailed in Section A of Appendix B (RFP Particulars), which outlines the required deliverables including a signed submission form, narrative response, pricing sheet, and requirements document. The RFP specifies that the new ERP will replace existing TIFIS system functionalities in finance, procurement, HR, payroll, and asset management, while TIFIS will continue to manage other tribal-specific services like housing and membership.
scope_of_deliverables.quote: Cowichan Tribes is seeking to procure a cloud-based ERP system(s) to enhance operational efficiency across key functions including finance, procurement, human resources, payroll, and asset management. The solution should be aligned with industry best practice, provide features to automate processes, provide staff and leadership access to the information needed to effectively plan and operate, and be adaptable to evolving business needs.

pricing_structure.value: Pricing is scored using the formula: (price threshold ÷ proponent's price) × weighting = proponent's pricing points. Pricing is worth 15 points in the total evaluation score. Pricing information must be submitted in a completed Pricing Excel Workbook (Appendix B – Section G) and must include details for implementing and supporting the solution over a 5-year period. Rates must be in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes, and must be all-inclusive (including labour, materials, travel, insurance, delivery, installation, set-up, and overhead).
pricing_structure.quote: Pricing is worth 15 points of the total score. Pricing will be scored based on a pricing formula using the rates set out in the Proponent’s submitted Pricing Sheet (Attachment 2). Each proponent will receive a percentage of the total possible points allocated to price, which will be calculated in accordance with the following formula: (price threshold ÷ proponent’s price) × weighting = proponent’s pricing points. Note on Threshold: Cowichan Tribes will not be publishing the price threshold that will be used in this calculation. However, the threshold will be based upon the projected costs and budget available for the implementation, licensing, and support of their ERP for the next five years. Instructions on How to Provide Pricing (a) Proponents should submit their pricing information by completing the attached Pricing Sheet and including it in their proposals. This includes details for implementing and supporting the solution over a 5-year period. (b) Rates must be provided in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes. (c) Unless otherwise indicated in the requested pricing information, rates quoted by the proponent must be all-inclusive and must include all labour and material costs, all travel and carriage costs, all insurance costs, all costs of delivery, all costs of installation and set-up, including any pre-delivery inspection charges, and all other overhead, including any fees or other charges required by law.

references_required.quote: At least two and at most five references for implementations involving the proposed solutions in Canada. Preference is for references to be First Nation clients. Each reference must include: Name of organization, Contact details of reference including name, title, email, and phone number, Description of the products implemented, Brief description of the services provided, Timeframe for the work completed

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: At the conclusion of the evaluation, Cowichan Tribes will conduct a cumulative assessment and invite the top two or three vendors to provide a demonstration at their discretion. 2.6 Stage V – Vendor Demonstrations Vendors selected for the demonstration stage will be required to present their proposed solutions in accordance with the demo script that will be provided by Cowichan Tribes. The script will outline the key functionalities and scenarios that must be addressed during the demonstration. To successfully pass this stage, vendors must demonstrate how their solution meets the specified requirements and effectively addresses the use cases outlined in the script. Failure to follow the script or demonstrate the required capabilities may impact the evaluation and progression to the next stage.
